property_summary: For any call to sendMoney, the total ETH balance of contract C must not increase after the call; the reference preserves this invariant by transferring _value out, but the buggy version breaks it by sending 0 ETH and keeping the balance unchanged when _value > 0 is sent along with the call.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a call that uses zero value, ignoring the _value parameter.
